title: Scan Visit
subtitle: Scan the customer's “My visit code” from the LiGETA app to record their visit.
pointCamera: Point the camera at the customer's code
alreadyToday: Already counted today - one visit per day per restaurant.
notRecognisedHint: Ask the customer to open “My visit code” again - the code changes every minute.
permissionNeeded: The camera is needed to scan customers' visit codes.
phoneOnly: Scanning works in the phone app. Open LiGETA Restaurant on a phone to scan visit codes.
